prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 465, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 466, 'component': 'Query Engine', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 467, 'component': 'Global API Gateway', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 468, 'component': 'Passwordless Auth Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 469, 'component': 'OAuth Authorization Server', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 470, 'component': 'Circuit Breaker', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 471, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'EU-Central', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 472, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'EU-West', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 473, 'component': 'Service Mesh Proxy', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 474, 'component': 'Anomaly Detection Engine', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 120}, {'i': 475, 'component': 'Central Reporting Data Store', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 476, 'component': 'Load Balancer', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 477, 'component': 'Client Error Reporting SDK', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 478, 'component': 'Sales Tax Filing Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 479, 'component': 'Region Failover Controller', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 120}]

response: {"incidents": [{"i": 465, "summary": "Global Job Scheduler degraded for an hour; batch processing stalled, causing delayed data updates."}, {"i": 466, "summary": "Major outage in the global Query Engine lasting 30 minutes; users reported slow or failed database lookups."}, {"i": 467, "summary": "Global API Gateway in ANZ experienced a critical failure, blocking external traffic for 2 hours."}, {"i": 468, "summary": "Passwordless Auth Service outage (global) for 2 hours; users were unable to log in without traditional credentials."}, {"i": 469, "summary": "OAuth Authorization Server incident prevented third-party app connections for 30 minutes."}, {"i": 470, "summary": "Global Circuit Breaker triggered major outages across dependent services for 30 minutes."}, {"i": 471, "summary": "Central Message Queue in EU-Central had a 30-minute major incident; background jobs stopped processing."}, {"i": 472, "summary": "SSO Broker (Shared) outage in EU-West caused login failures for enterprise customers for 30 minutes."}, {"i": 473, "summary": "Major global Service Mesh Proxy failure for 2 hours; inter-service communication was significantly degraded."}, {"i": 474, "summary": "Anomaly Detection Engine was down globally for 2 hours, resulting in missed alerts and delayed incident response."}, {"i": 475, "summary": "Central Reporting Data Store in ANZ had a major incident for 60 minutes; dashboards showed stale or missing data."}, {"i": 476, "summary": "CRITICAL: Global Load Balancer failure lasted 3 hours, causing widespread service unavailability."}, {"i": 477, "summary": "Client Error Reporting SDK in US-West failed critically for 5 hours, blinding us to user-facing issues."}, {"i": 478, "summary": "Sales Tax Filing Connector outage for 1 hour; automated tax filings were delayed for affected merchants."}, {"i": 479, "summary": "CRITICAL: Region Failover Controller incident (global) for 2 hours left us unable to reroute traffic during other outages."}]}
